root.label: New York Medicaid system rollout begins

events.label: New York Medicaid system rollout begins

slots.name: enrollee count
slots.sentence: New York’s Department of Health began transitioning more than 147,000 Medicaid and Medicare Savings Program enrollees to an upgraded case management system about a year ago.

slots.name: rollout start date
slots.sentence: The state began rolling out the new Medicaid Eligibility and Client Management system in September 2025.

slots.name: extension amount
slots.sentence: The latest amendment included an $866 million extension along with a work plan modification, according to details of the contract listed in the Open Book New York database.

slots.name: automatic renewal rate
slots.sentence: Since then, state officials say only a third of them have been able to automatically renew their coverage without assistance.
